description: Use this when the user wants to work on something they already made in appdesigns: change a screenshot set, a header or event art they saved, add to a project, or see what a project still lacks. Lists their projects (one per app) with every saved asset in each (asset_id, kind, canvas size, last edit) and what each project still needs. Needs the user signed in to appdesigns; a call without it fails asking for sign-in, and then the user signs in (in Claude Code type /mcp, pick appdesigns and choose Authenticate (or run `claude mcp login appdesigns` in a separate terminal), in Codex run `codex mcp login appdesigns`; other agents open the sign-in page themselves). Read-only.

query.description: Only projects or assets whose name contains this, ignoring case.

name: list_projects
title: List the user's appdesigns projects
